title: Design Microservice Architectures the Right Way
summary: Michael Bryzek of Flow gives a QCon London 2018 talk on key decisions for building maintainable microservices. It covers infrastructure, continuous deployment, communication, event streaming and language choice.
why: HN commenters recommend it for showing the tooling possible when schemas and APIs are treated as code.

quote.text: There's a great talk that I highly recommend about some of the magic you can do
